description: This file defines the type declaration for the 'Denque' class, which is a double-ended queue implementation with various methods for manipulating the queue, along with an interface for options.

classes.name: Denque
classes.description: A class representing a double-ended queue (deque) with methods for pushing, popping, shifting, unshifting, peeking, removing, splicing, and conversion to array or string.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the deque.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Adds an item to the front of the deque.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the end of the deque.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the front of the deque.

methods.name: peekBack
methods.description: Returns the item at the back of the deque without removing it.

methods.name: peekFront
methods.description: Returns the item at the front of the deque without removing it.

methods.name: peekAt
methods.description: Returns the item at a specific index.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the item at the specified index.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a number of items starting at the specified index.

methods.name: removeOne
methods.description: Removes and returns a single item at the specified index.

methods.name: splice
methods.description: Removes and optionally replaces a number of items starting from the specified index.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the deque is empty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the deque.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the deque.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the deque to its string representation.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing the items of the deque.
